materialization.notes: Materialized 167 variables via the repo-owned plugin's upsert rail against the canonical Collider file; existing VariableIDs preserved for downstream component bindings (spot-checked 2019:370 text/primary, 2019:354 background/base, 2220:695 accent/dark/primary). Count fell from 699 because the tailwind-colors, tailwind-variables, theme, and font families are now withheld from the Figma publish only — they remain in the token source and in tokens.css, so no public token ID was removed.
